plugins.name: Documentation Methodology
plugins.description: Lightweight, ID-anchored, arc42-inspired documentation methodology. Enforces stable IDs, immutable accepted ADRs, traceability.yaml spine, and the right template for each artifact (REQ-F, REQ-NF, ADR, ARCH, API, UI, TC).
plugins.author: svnstfns

plugins.name: TrueNAS MCP
plugins.description: Deploy and manage TrueNAS Scale Docker apps from Claude Code. Bundles five skills (discovery, planning, deploy/verify, troubleshoot, purge) and two slash commands that drive the truenas-mcp MCP server. Server is fetched at runtime via uvx — no separate install.
plugins.author: svnstfns
